caveat_1_36m_rolling_warm_up.description: 45 features with 36m rolling window become usable only from sig_date 2016-12-29 (3-year warm-up). At sig_date 2014-01-29, NA rate = 1.0 for these features.
caveat_1_36m_rolling_warm_up.PIT_compliance: CORRECT — rolling window cannot reach back beyond available data
caveat_1_36m_rolling_warm_up.DPL_implication: Effective training period after 36m rolling features become usable = 2017-01-31 ~ 2026-04-30 = 112 sig_dates. If 36m features required, walk-forward windows further compressed.
caveat_1_36m_rolling_warm_up.recommended_action: training_protocol.md Option A: drop 36m rolling features (45) and accept 1002 effective features starting 2015-02 (12m lag warm-up). Option B: retain 36m features and accept effective training from 2017-01 with 112 sig_dates.

caveat_2_macro_FRED_warm_up.description: Macro features (FRED + ECOS, 60 features) at sig_date 2014-01-29 ~ 2022-12 have NA rate = 1.0. From 2023+ become non-NA.
caveat_2_macro_FRED_warm_up.PIT_compliance: TBD — requires verification of upstream data_collector_fred.R timestamp / data source availability
caveat_2_macro_FRED_warm_up.DPL_implication: Macro features effectively unusable for ~9 years of training period. Either drop macro features (60) or restrict training to 2023+ (effective 28 sig_dates, infeasible for walk-forward).
caveat_2_macro_FRED_warm_up.recommended_action: DROP macro features (60) from DPL training input. Effective feature count: 955 KEEP - 60 macro = 895 features. Macro family loss may reduce regime-conditional alpha but acceptable given training sample priority. ALTERNATIVELY: investigate FRED upstream data — if PIT-CORRECT (data not historically available), exclude. If PIT-INCORRECT (data exists but missed by build), fix at WT_008 level.
caveat_2_macro_FRED_warm_up.follow_up_required: Forge agent verify build_features_pool.R Layer E FRED data source — `02_Infrastructure/data/data_collector_fred.R` first available date check. If FRED series start dates are post-2022, this is PIT-correct and macros must be dropped.

caveat_3_recent_sig_date_sparsity.description: Recent sig_dates (2024+) show increasing NA rate for some fundamental features (e.g., fdb_m_AC01_Total_Accruals_CF NA rate 0.072 → 0.282 → 0.723 from 2020 to 2026-04). This is consistent with quarterly financial statement lag (C4) — recent quarter not yet reported.
caveat_3_recent_sig_date_sparsity.PIT_compliance: CORRECT — quarterly financial statement 45-day lag enforced (C4)
caveat_3_recent_sig_date_sparsity.DPL_implication: Test-period predictions (2026-04) have higher missing rate. Imputation via cross-section median per sig_date handles this gracefully.
caveat_3_recent_sig_date_sparsity.recommended_action: Cross-section median imputation per sig_date per feature in pre-processing. NO future imputation.

caveat_4_C13_NEGATE_FLIP_SIGN_NOT_INSPEC.description: Z_Score_Aligned C13 directive is enforced at factor_db_connector level for fdb_m_* features. However, Layer C/D/E/F/G/H/I features built downstream may inadvertently flip signs. build_features_pool.R inspected for `*-1`, `NEGATE`, `FLIP_SIGN` patterns: none found. Explicit Layer F/G/H interaction sign decisions are inherited from base (no manual flip).
caveat_4_C13_NEGATE_FLIP_SIGN_NOT_INSPEC.DPL_implication: None — DPL is sign-agnostic at training time (network learns sign through Score Head)

caveat_5_VARIANT_check_pit_features.description: 58 features with `screening_recommendation = VARIANT_check_pit` — high missing rate (30~40%) suggests data coverage issue, requires individual PIT verification.
caveat_5_VARIANT_check_pit_features.PIT_compliance: TBD — these are consensus / forecast data with coverage gaps (small-cap stocks lack analyst coverage)
caveat_5_VARIANT_check_pit_features.DPL_implication: Cross-section imputation handles graceful but missing pattern is non-random (correlated with cap / coverage)
caveat_5_VARIANT_check_pit_features.recommended_action: EXCLUDE 58 VARIANT features from DPL v1.0 training. Accept 955 KEEP only. Reduce to 955 - 60 macro = 895 effective features after caveat_2 mitigation.
